semiconductor_relevance: High — YMT Co., Ltd specializes in specialty chemicals for the semiconductor industry, particularly in surface treatment processes.
summary: YMT Co., Ltd is a leading supplier of specialty chemicals and materials for the semiconductor industry, focusing on electroplating and electroless plating processes. The company is recognized for its high-quality products tailored for 5G high-frequency applications and has established a strong presence in various Asian markets.
capabilities: Surface treatment chemicals for flexible and rigid-flex boards

regional_presence.Taiwan: YMT has established a branch in Taiwan to provide high-quality technical services.
regional_presence.Korea: YMT is the largest supplier of specialty chemicals in Korea, with a strong focus on quality assurance and customer service.
regional_presence.China: The company has subsidiaries in Shenzhen and Kunshan to support localized production and service.
